title: Affine free presentations for finite-type constructible modules over Noetherian rings
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $R$ a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Work with sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant ring sheaf $R_X$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. A sheaf of $R_X$-modules is called constructible if it admits a finite partition by locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification] whose strata are constructible subsets of $X$ [def-weil-constructible-subset] and on which its inverse-image restrictions are locally constant with finitely generated $R$-module values [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Every constructible sheaf $F$ admits finite families of affine etale $X$-schemes $U_i$ and $V_j$ and an exact sequence $\bigoplus_{j=1}^m j_{V_j!}R_{V_j}\longrightarrow\bigoplus_{i=1}^n j_{U_i!}R_{U_i}\longrightarrow F\longrightarrow0$, where $j_!$ is the sheafified etale sum-extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension]. Both $m,n$ may be zero. There is no finiteness requirement on the underlying sets of $R$ or of the module values. The constructibility of the strata is part of the hypothesis; it is automatic when $X$ is Noetherian.
